description: Record mutations (spec/SPEC.md §7). D1: rotations without a valid countersignature. D3: the validity window. D4: caps and bounds. D5: hostile relay URLs, the form only. D6: duplicate members. P2: number spellings of iat, ttl and exp. F7: S + L on a record signature, and the small-order and non-canonical Ed25519 encodings as a record key with R the identity and S = 0, over an arbitrary and a ground digest.
test_data: Every seed, private key, content key and nonce in this file is test data: each comes from xorshiftRng(20261025) (packages/core/test/support/rng.ts). They are public; never let them protect anything real.
